settings.preset_3dprint_desc: Recommended for 3D printing. Checks all repair options to guarantee a 100% watertight closed solid and prevent slicer errors.
settings.preset_game_desc: Recommended for game assets & rendering. Unifies normals and cleans degenerate faces without forcefully closing open conduits or artistic holes.
settings.preset_asis_desc: Unchecks all repair options. Preserves 100% original vertices and topology, purely converting the file format without modifications.
settings.auto_fill_holes_tip: When to use: Mandatory for 3D printing solid parts. Uncheck if your model is intentionally designed with open surfaces or pipes.
settings.fix_non_manifold_tip: When to use: When edges are shared by >2 faces or vertices self-intersect, causing slicer slicing errors.
settings.unify_normals_tip: When to use: When 3D rendering shows dark inverted shadows or flipped face orientations.
settings.remove_degenerate_tip: When to use: Removes zero-area needle triangles and duplicate overlapping faces to reduce file size and optimize rendering.
settings.privacy_guarantee: 100% Client-Side Offline: Models never leave your device. Zero privacy risk.

manual.title: OmniSeam 3D Official User & Operations Manual
manual.subtitle: Step-by-Step Guide · 3D Viewport Controls & Self-Hosting Instructions
manual.quickstart_banner_desc: OmniSeam 3D features intelligent format detection and autonomous surface-healing engines. Whether you are a 3D printing maker, mechanical engineer, or 3D artist, convert models in seconds.
manual.step1_desc: Supports STEP, IGES, SolidWorks, STL, OBJ, 3MF, IFC, DXF and more. Automatic topology inspection runs instantly.
manual.step2_desc: 1-click switch between [🖨️ 3D Print / Mfg], [🎮 Game / Render], or [🔍 Raw Geometry], or adjust advanced tolerances.
manual.step3_desc: Rapid defect healing & format export with side-by-side comparison, deviation heatmap, and instant download.
manual.preset_3dprint_desc: Enforces full auto-hole filling, boundary loop sewing, and normal unification to guarantee a 100% watertight solid.
manual.preset_game_desc: Unifies surface normals while preserving intentional hollow tubes and stylized openings without forced closure.
manual.preset_asis_desc: 100% preservation of original vertices and triangles for pure file format translation.
manual.control_lmb_desc: 360° free orbit rotation of the 3D space.
manual.control_rmb_desc: Pan viewport camera center horizontally & vertically.
manual.control_wheel_desc: Zoom in and out of the 3D model.
manual.mode_shaded_bullet: Shaded PBR: Standard metallic/roughness physical lighting for surface inspection.
manual.mode_wireframe_bullet: Wireframe: Inspect mesh density, triangle distribution, and edge loops in real time.
manual.mode_normals_bullet: Normals: Visualizes surface normal orientations with RGB colors to detect inverted facets.
manual.mode_xray_bullet: X-Ray: Transparent see-through view to inspect internal voids or self-intersections.
manual.mode_heatmap_bullet: Deviation Heatmap: Color spectrum (Green 0.00mm - Yellow 0.025mm - Red ≥0.05mm) showing micron-level deviation caused by auto-healing.
manual.tool_measure_bullet: 3D Distance Ruler: Click any two points on the model to calculate exact Euclidean distance in millimeters.
manual.tool_section_bullet: Dynamic Section Plane: Slice through geometry to inspect internal wall thickness and infill solid state.
manual.engine_heading: Dual Engine Architecture: Pure Client vs Cloud Server Node
manual.engine_desc: OmniSeam 3D employs hybrid offloading to automatically select optimal compute power based on file format:
manual.engine_client_b2: Files never leave your device for maximum privacy
manual.engine_client_b3: Supports STL, OBJ, 3MF, STEP, PLY, OFF, DXF & standard formats
manual.engine_server_b1: Equipped with FreeCAD & OpenCASCADE B-Rep CAD kernels
manual.engine_server_b2: Dedicated to proprietary SolidWorks, Inventor, and IFC files
manual.engine_server_b3: 1-click Duplicate to your private Hugging Face Space or Docker
manual.slicer_question: Why do slicers like Cura, PrusaSlicer, or Bambu Studio report 'Non-manifold edges' or 'Model is not watertight'?
manual.slicer_watertight_desc: Every triangle edge must be shared by exactly 2 triangles. If shared by 1, it is an open hole; if shared by more than 2, it is non-manifold, causing slicers to fail when determining internal vs external volume.
manual.slicer_overhang_desc: In FDM 3D printing without supports, overhang structures beyond 45° collapse under gravity. OmniSeam 3D marks overhang areas (mm²) and estimates support volume (cm³) in the audit report.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Data Security Statement
privacy.subtitle: Enterprise Confidentiality · 100% Client-Side Offline · Zero Data Retention
privacy.banner_title: 100% Absolute Confidentiality Guarantee for your 3D CAD Files
privacy.banner_desc: 3D models represent your most critical intellectual property. OmniSeam 3D is architected around Pure Client offline execution and isolated private compute spaces to ensure zero data leakage.
privacy.pillar1_desc: Standard meshes and CAD files process entirely inside your browser via WebAssembly. 0% network file transfer.
privacy.pillar2_desc: We never log or transmit model filenames, dimensions, vertices, or geometric metadata.
privacy.pillar3_desc: Dedicated nodes on Hugging Face Spaces or local Docker run in isolated sandboxes with ephemeral storage.
privacy.pillar4_desc: The complete codebase is publicly open on GitHub under MIT/Apache-2.0. No hidden backdoors or vendor lock-in.
